## 1) Severity: HIGH | Type: Bug
Consensus: 2/3 reviewers
Title: Make a skipped Grafana prom rule deny all abilities instead of granting Duplicate

Affected:
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/hooks/useAbilities.ts:287-318
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/hooks/useAbilities.ts:349-356
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/hooks/useAbilities.ts:397-406
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/components/rule-viewer/AlertRuleMenu.tsx:67-92

Explanation:
`AlertRuleMenu` passes `skipToken` when `promRule` is not a Grafana rule, for example cloud/Mimir/Loki rules or callers that pass no `promRule`. The hook then still produces a positive Duplicate ability:

- `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` receives `undefined`.
- `useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable(undefined)` returns `loading: false`.
- `MaybeSupported` becomes `AlwaysSupported`, and `duplicateSupported` is `AlwaysSupported`.
- Duplicate becomes `toAbility(AlwaysSupported, getRulesPermissions('grafana').create)`.

`AlertRuleMenu` combines the two checks with `canDuplicate = rulerDup || grafanaDup`. As a result, any user with Grafana rule-create permission sees "Duplicate" on data-source-managed rules. This happens even when the ruler-based check says the action is unsupported (ruler unavailable) or not permitted.

The skipped branch fails open. It should contribute `NotSupported` for every action.

Proposed fix:
~~~ts
const abilities = useMemo<Abilities<AlertRuleAction>>(() => {
  if (!rule) {
    return Object.fromEntries(
      Object.values(AlertRuleAction).map((a) => [a, [NotSupported, false]])
    ) as Abilities<AlertRuleAction>;
  }
  ...
}, [...]);
~~~

## 2) Severity: HIGH | Type: Bug
Consensus: 1/3 reviewers
Title: Restore federated-group immutability in useAllAlertRuleAbilities

Affected:
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/hooks/useAbilities.ts:222-229
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/hooks/useAbilities.ts:242-250

Explanation:
`useAllAlertRuleAbilities(rule: CombinedRule)` previously computed `isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)`. It now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which hard-codes `isFederated = false`.

Legacy callers that use `CombinedRule` (legacy list, rule details, viewer) will now report rules in Mimir federated groups as editable, deletable and pausable. This is a regression introduced by the refactor.

Pass the federation flag through to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities` and apply it.

Proposed fix:
~~~ts
export function useAllAlertRuleAbilities(rule: CombinedRule): Abilities<AlertRuleAction> {
  const groupIdentifierV2 = useMemo(() => groupIdentifier.fromCombinedRule(rule), [rule]);
  return useAllRulerRuleAbilities(rule.rulerRule, groupIdentifierV2, isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group));
}

export function useAllRulerRuleAbilities(rule, groupIdentifier, isFederated = false) { ... }
~~~

## 3) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Bug
Consensus: 2/3 reviewers
Title: Use the ruler result as authoritative instead of OR-ing ruler and prom abilities

Affected:
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/components/rule-viewer/AlertRuleMenu.tsx:81-100
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/rule-list/components/RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx:53-61
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/hooks/useAbilities.ts:296-310
- public/app/types/unified-alerting-dto.ts:135

Explanation:
When both `rulerRule` and a Grafana `promRule` are available, each capability is computed as `ruler || prom`. The prom path decides immutability from the newly added optional `GrafanaPromRuleDTO.provenance`. Nothing in the diff shows that the Prometheus-compatible API actually returns this field.

If the field is absent:
- `isProvisionedPromRule` returns false.
- The prom path marks provisioned rules as editable, deletable and pausable.
- Because of the OR, this overrides the ruler path, which correctly marks them immutable.

To fix:
- Use the prom-based check only as a fallback when no ruler rule is present.
- Verify that the backend populates `provenance`.

Proposed fix:
~~~ts
const useProm = !rulerRule && prometheusRuleType.grafana.rule(promRule);
const grafanaAbilities = useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(useProm ? promRule : skipToken, MENU_ACTIONS);
const pick = (ruler: Ability, prom: Ability) => (useProm ? prom : ruler);
const [pauseSupported, pauseAllowed] = pick(rulerPauseAbility, grafanaPauseAbility);
const canPause = pauseSupported && pauseAllowed;
// same for delete/duplicate/silence/export and edit in RuleActionsButtons
~~~

## 4) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Bug
Consensus: 1/3 reviewers
Title: Restore the `key` prop on GrafanaRuleListItem rendered in a list

Affected:
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/rule-list/FilterView.tsx:157-162

Explanation:
The previous `<GrafanaRuleLoader key={key} …/>` was replaced by `<GrafanaRuleListItem …/>` without a `key`. These items are rendered from a list.

Missing keys have two effects:
- React emits key warnings.
- React reconciles by index, so component state can be reused across different rules as results stream in or reorder. Affected state includes open menus, delete modals and clone redirect state.

Proposed fix:
~~~tsx
<GrafanaRuleListItem
  key={key}
  rule={rule}
  groupIdentifier={groupIdentifier}
  namespaceName={ruleWithOrigin.namespaceName}
  showLocation={true}
/>
~~~

## 5) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Performance
Consensus: 1/3 reviewers
Title: Avoid evaluating ability hook pipelines multiple times per rule row

Affected:
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/rule-list/components/RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx:53-61
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/components/rule-viewer/AlertRuleMenu.tsx:56-100
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/hooks/useAbilities.ts:287-293

Explanation:
Each row in the list view computes abilities several times:

- **Ruler pipeline with no ruler rule.** `RuleActionsButtons` calls `useRulerRuleAbility`, and `AlertRuleMenu` calls `useRulerRuleAbilities`, even though `rule` is always undefined in the list view. Each call still runs `useIsRuleEditable`, `useAlertingAbility` and `useCanSilence`.
- **Grafana prom pipeline twice with identical inputs.** `RuleActionsButtons` calls `useGrafanaPromRuleAbility`, and its child `AlertRuleMenu` calls `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`. Each one runs `useFolder`, `useGrafanaRulesSilenceSupport`, `useCanSilenceInFolder` and `useAlertingAbility`. The inline `// duplicate` comment at line 289 acknowledges this.

Per row this is roughly four ability computations where one is needed. Subscriptions, memo recomputations and re-renders scale with the number of rows.

To fix:
- Compute abilities once and pass the results down to `AlertRuleMenu`.
- Add a skip path for the ruler hook when `rule` is undefined.

Proposed fix:
~~~tsx
const rulerAbilities = useAllRulerRuleAbilities(rule ?? skipToken, groupIdentifier); // add skipToken support
const promAbilities = useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(
  prometheusRuleType.grafana.rule(promRule) ? promRule : undefined
);
// pass computed canPause/canDelete/... down to AlertRuleMenu
~~~

## 6) Severity: LOW | Type: Performance
Consensus: 2/3 reviewers
Title: Hoist inline action arrays so ability-hook useMemo is effective

Affected:
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/components/rule-viewer/AlertRuleMenu.tsx:57-79
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/hooks/useAbilities.ts:397-406

Explanation:
`useRulerRuleAbilities` and `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` memoize on `[abilities, actions]`. `AlertRuleMenu` passes a new array literal on every render. The memo therefore never hits, and a new `Ability[]` is allocated for every row on every render.

Hoist the action list to a module-level constant.

Proposed fix:
~~~ts
const MENU_ACTIONS = [
  AlertRuleAction.Pause,
  AlertRuleAction.Delete,
  AlertRuleAction.Duplicate,
  AlertRuleAction.Silence,
  AlertRuleAction.ModifyExport,
];
useRulerRuleAbilities(rulerRule, groupIdentifier, MENU_ACTIONS);
useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(isGrafanaPromRule ? promRule : skipToken, MENU_ACTIONS);
~~~

## 7) Severity: LOW | Type: Bug
Consensus: 1/3 reviewers
Title: Restore returnTo on the rule view link

Affected:
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/rule-list/GrafanaRuleListItem.tsx:40

Explanation:
The deleted implementation built `href` with `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo })`. The new component drops `returnTo`. Navigating to a rule's view page from the list therefore no longer returns the user to the filtered list state, which looks like an unintended regression.

Proposed fix:
~~~tsx
const returnTo = createReturnTo();
...
href: createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`, { returnTo }),
~~~

## 8) Severity: LOW | Type: Performance
Consensus: 1/3 reviewers
Title: Memoize Grafana prom abilities on stable fields rather than the polled rule object

Affected:
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/hooks/useAbilities.ts:295-334
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/hooks/useAbilities.ts:349-378

Explanation:
`GrafanaGroupLoader` polls the Prometheus groups endpoint, and every poll produces new rule objects. Both `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` and `useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable` include `rule` in their memo dependencies.

As a result, every poll invalidates the ability maps for all visible rows and re-renders the action components, even when permissions have not changed. Key the memos on the stable primitives the abilities actually depend on.

Proposed fix:
~~~ts
const folderUid = rule?.folderUid;
const provenance = rule?.provenance;
const ruleType = rule?.type;
const pluginProvided = rule ? isPluginProvidedRule(rule) : false;
const abilities = useMemo(() => { /* use primitives */ },
  [folderUid, provenance, ruleType, pluginProvided, loading, isEditable, isRemovable,
   canSilenceInFolder, exportAllowed, silenceSupported]);
~~~

## 9) Severity: LOW | Type: Test
Consensus: 1/3 reviewers
Title: Assert Pause/Delete explicitly instead of a brittle exact menu-item count

Affected:
- public/app/features/alerting/unified/rule-list/GrafanaGroupLoader.test.tsx:171-207

Explanation:
The test grants `AlertingRuleUpdate` and `AlertingRuleDelete`, and the Edit button is expected to be present. Yet the test asserts exactly 4 menu items and never checks Pause or Delete.

Either the count is fragile, or the test locks in a gap where Pause and Delete are not offered in the list view despite the permissions. Assert the expected items explicitly and drop the hard-coded count.

Proposed fix:
~~~ts
expect(byRole('menuitem', { name: /pause/i }).get()).toBeInTheDocument();
expect(ui.menuItems.delete().get()).toBeInTheDocument();
// remove expect(menuItems.length).toBe(4) or derive it from the asserted set
~~~

true_positives.golden_comment: The rendered GrafanaRuleListItem is missing the required key prop for React list items. This can cause rendering issues when the list order changes.
true_positives.matched_candidate: GrafanaRuleListItem rendered in a list is missing the key prop, causing React key warnings and potential state reuse across different rules during reordering
true_positives.reasoning: The candidate issue identifies the exact same problem as the golden comment: the GrafanaRuleListItem component rendered in a list is missing the required key prop. Both comments point out this is a React list rendering issue that can cause problems with state management and rendering when list order changes.

false_positives.candidate: useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities returns positive Duplicate ability when promRule is skipped (not a Grafana rule), causing any user with Grafana rule-create permission to see Duplicate on data-source-managed rules even when ruler-based check says action is unsupported

useAllAlertRuleAbilities lost federated-group immutability check after refactor - isFederated is now hard-coded to false in useAllRulerRuleAbilities, causing rules in Mimir federated groups to incorrectly report as editable, deletable and pausable

OR-ing ruler and prom abilities causes provisioned rules to be marked as editable/deletable/pausable when GrafanaPromRuleDTO.provenance field is absent, overriding the correct ruler path immutability check

Ability hook pipelines are evaluated multiple times per rule row - ruler pipeline runs even when rule is undefined, and Grafana prom pipeline runs twice with identical inputs in RuleActionsButtons and AlertRuleMenu
Inline action arrays passed to useRulerRuleAbilities and useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities cause useMemo to never hit cache since new array literal is created on every render
returnTo parameter was dropped when replacing GrafanaRuleLoader with GrafanaRuleListItem, breaking navigation back to filtered list state from rule view page
Grafana prom abilities memoization depends on polled rule object reference instead of stable primitive fields, causing unnecessary re-renders on every poll even when permissions haven't changed
Test asserts exact count of 4 menu items instead of explicitly checking for Pause and Delete menu items, making test brittle and potentially masking missing functionality

false_negatives.golden_comment: RuleActionsButtons is invoked with only promRule, but SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer inside RuleActionsButtons still depends on a Grafana Ruler rule being present, so for Grafana rules coming from list views the 'Silence notifications' menu entry (now driven by Grafana Prom abilities) will toggle showSilenceDrawer without ever rendering the drawer. This means clicking 'Silence notifications' for these rules has no visible effect, even when abilities indicate silencing is allowed.
